name: Chamillionaire
sources: style-research-extended vol.1 crunk — Chamillionaire (the `houston-screw` lane's research section)
notes: The melodic wing of the lane, and the least static model in it — the one Houston entry where the harmony actually moves and says so out loud. ▶ **"Sung hooks make the harmony explicit" is the whole entry.** Everywhere else in this lane the chord is implied by a riff and held for bars; here `harmonicRhythm` weights `1_per_bar` highest, `chordDurationBeats` narrows to 4–8, seventh colour rises to 0.34, and `impliedByRiff` is deliberately *not* set. A hook someone sings over a stated 4-bar loop is a hook with real changes under it. ▶ **`melody.phraseBars` reaching 8 is a direct quote** — "his own sung hook lines carry 4–8 bar melodic phrases" — and it is the longest phrase length authored anywhere in this batch. `structure` is `question_answer` for the same reason: a 4–8 bar sung line is not a riff loop, it is a phrase and its answer. ▶ **The only 16th-dominant hat kit in the lane.** The research says "16th hats with rolls; snare-roll builds into hooks" — Atlanta density on a Houston tempo — so the hat base is weighted towards 16ths against every neighbour here, and `rolls.freqPerBar` sits at the top of this band at 0.25. The build is the roll's `gapProb` of 0.06: almost no gaps is what a roll that runs into a hook sounds like. ▶ **The 808 and the bass are two voices, not one.** "808 root with medium decay; synth bass doubling under the sung hook" — so the 808 stays at 14–28 and the played bass is authored *above* it at 20–40, doubling rather than replacing. `followRootsProb` drops to 0.9, the loosest in the batch outside Z-Ro, because a doubling line over four moving chords has somewhere to go. ⚠ **`confidence` is medium because the research says so**, and the tempo band carries its own [LOW-CONF]. Sourced: the melodic sung-hook lane, i–VI–VII and i–VII–VI over 4-bar loops, the 16th-hat/snare-roll kit, the 808-plus-synth-bass pairing, the 4–8 bar phrase length, and the 8-bar-hook-first form with hook ×3. INFERRED: every probability and register bound, and the third progression family. ⚠ **The i–VII family is INFERRED** — the research names only the two three-chord families. It carries the lowest weight and exists so the chord part reaches its distinctness floor. ⚠ **Fill fingerprint.** `gapProb` 0.06 / `descendProb` 0.55 / `rampJitter` 19 over 8th-triplets, even grouping — the least gapped roll in the band, which is the build the research names. ⚠ `anticipationProb` raised to 0.15. With `mirror_kick` against a fully locked 808 both parts take every kick, so every bass onset lands exactly on an 808 onset — `coherence.rs` calls that one line played twice rather than two parts locking. The lock is the style and is untouched; the anticipation is what makes them two parts.
